a: An inverted index maps terms to the documents that contain them.
BM25 is a ranking function for keyword relevance in search engines.
TF-IDF ranks documents higher when terms are frequent in-doc but rare globally.
Semantic search matches meaning via embeddings, not only exact keywords.
Hybrid search combines keyword and vector retrieval for better results.
Elasticsearch is a distributed search and analytics engine built on Lucene.
Autocomplete suggests queries/documents as the user types using prefixes/tries.
Facets let users filter results by categories/attributes with counts.
Stop words are common words often ignored in classic keyword indexes.
Stemming normalizes word variants so 'running' matches 'run'.
